extras.approval_status: DRAFT — no political judgment involved (pure vote-option vocabulary + term dates), does not require D7 sign-off the way govity/wpca's government_groups does. Ready to use as-is.
extras.vocabulary_source: brno/config/sources.yml's vote_option_vocabulary: schema-CZ.json's single-letter hlas codes, A/N/Z -> yes/no/abstain (present), '–' (absent, en dash) -> absent, X (Nehlasoval/a) -> not voting, mirroring the cz-psp-data-2025-202x convention of grouping 'not voting' with absent for attendance purposes.
extras.since_rationale: 2022-10-20 = start_date of the assembly term per brno/data/memberships.csv (first session Z9/01). until=null: the term has not ended as of this file's creation (2026-08-26); the origin feed's last observed session is Z9/36 (2026-06-23), with Z9/37 (2026-09-15) scheduled but not yet held.
